segments.text: The human body is an astonishingly complex system made up of about 37 trillion cells.
The heart beats about 100,000 times a day, and the lungs breathe in and out about 20,000 times a day.
The food we eat is digested in the stomach and intestines
And is delivered as energy to tissues throughout the body
Nutrients such as protein, vitamins and minerals
Are essential for the body's repair and growth
The three pillars of staying healthy are said to be moderate exercise
A balanced diet and sufficient sleep
When these are broken, the risk of various diseases rises
Lack of exercise can cause heart disease and diabetes
Too much salt or sugar leads to high blood pressure and obesity
Like a sleep weakens the immune system
It makes a person more likely to fall ill
Stress affects not only mental health
But also physical health in serious ways
Chronic stress can cause digest of trouble headaches, sleeplessness and depression
Regular medical checks help to detect disease early
Physicians listen to a patient's lifestyle and when needed suggest a treatment
The body is the most precious tool that has been given to each of us
The small choices of each day support a long life
Health is not something we attend to only on special occasions
But something that lives in the daily fabric of our lives
